target.statement: MSDE achieves mean AUC-ROC of 0.925 across 46 ADBench datasets (averaged over 4 anomaly types and 3 seeds, zero noise).

compute.basis: No MSDE code is released (only a placeholder GitHub link); the agent must reimplement the full MSDE pipeline (UMAP fuzzy graph, binary-search radius, multi-radius weights, iterative weighted mean-shift with NN-Descent) and run it over 46 datasets x 4 anomaly modes x 3 seeds, plus download ADBench data and baselines; the paper's own runtime on a 285k-sample dataset was ~281 s per run, so the full 46-dataset sweep is hours of CPU work.

blockers: No code released for MSDE (GitHub link is a placeholder/empty org)
Full ADBench protocol requires 46 datasets x 4 anomaly modes x 3 seeds
Reimplementation of UMAP fuzzy graph + NN-Descent + mean-shift from paper text only
title: Anomaly Detection via Mean Shift Density Enhancement
